input_scope: All comparable EX15/23/22/24/25 standard accounts plus EX27; EX14 and technical failures retained as historical noncomparable evidence
selection_disclosure: Methods chosen after seeing prior results; this is not blind validation. All comparable qualified configuration identities are ranked, including equivalent behavior and distinct source versions.

search_bias.population: All comparable distinct nonconstant economic return paths including nonqualified configurations
search_bias.count_interpretation: 588 comparable standard proposals; 685 adds 96 wrong-warmup EX14 accounts and 1 archived EX18 baseline repeat. EX17 failed before persisting a complete account. Not a full S010/S011 mechanism-research upper bound.
limitations: Adaptive selection and prior mechanism research remain outside correction
PBO selects Sharpe winners and does not reproduce the original constrained multiobjective optimizer
Effective count is a correlation-model diagnostic, not an independent evidence count

ranking.research_family_metrics: PBO and effective count disclosed separately; not duplicated as per-configuration ranking objectives
ranking.sensitivity: Also report layers without kNN, whose coverage is sparse and nonuniform

unmeasured: New balanced joint perturbations are not run; only observed joint changes and full-ledger neighbors are measured
Order queue, market impact, capacity, latency and missed-touch perturbations
